Methodological quality Studies evaluating Xpert Ultra on sputum specimens (15 studies) In the patient selection domain, for MRS, we judged the risk of bias as low for most studies (13/15, 86.7%) and high for two studies (2/15, 13.3%) because in one study participants with definitive tuberculosis were excluded (Liu 2021) and in the other, the sampling method was retrospective and by convenience (Enimil 2022). Regarding applicability, we judged low concern for most studies (12/15, 80%). We judged high concern for two studies (2/15, 13.3%) because participants were enrolled exclusively as inpatients in tertiary care centers. We judged unclear concern for one study (1/15, 6.7%) because the setting was undefined.
